name.description: Read this note (its name as listed, e.g. partners/acme); leave out to list or search

ref.description: Read this note by the ref of a hit (always exact, also when the listed name was shortened); instead of name

query.description: Case-insensitive text to find in name, title, topics or content

limit.description: Hits per page when listing or searching

offset.description: Listing: number of hits to skip. Reading: character offset in the note content (use nextOffset)
